disposition_precedence: send an unmerged item to human review when its total-attempt limit is exhausted
hold an unattempted item when a dependency needs human review or is held
isolate and reduce scope before replay when the same failure signature reaches the repeat limit
replay a smaller failing unit when the latest required gate failed and attempts remain
resume a stalled queue entry when its latest required gates all pass
restart_order: Schedule resumable and replayable items in topological waves; an item may share a wave only with items it does not depend on.
human_approval_required_for: dependency chain blocked by an exhausted item
